examples.text: Bill runs a Skool community helping people bookkeep better and generates $62,000 per month in revenue. Jamie runs a Skool community helping women invest and generates $41,000 per month. Both are cited by Alex Hormozi from Skool's real leaderboard as high-end examples of community monetization on the platform (2026).

practices.text: Launch a Skool community (free or paid) around a topic you want to talk about; the platform allows the host to control who is admitted and what price point to charge.
